build.notes: Values at pin be3d36ed7 (v0.9.3-60-gbe3d36ed, 2026-11-02 win-cpu full build): 134 model_specs families -> 137 linked loaders (134 + 3 bundled VADs: silero_vad, marblenet_vad, earshot_vad), catalog 137 entries, 421 downloadable packages, 17 tasks. Loader/catalog counts re-verified at release time.
